# NEXT3LABS

> NEXT3LABS PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based AI-powered engineering studio. We build
> and run high-stakes custom software for businesses — engineering excellence since
> 2016, AI-adapted.

NEXT3LABS is a small, senior engineering studio based in Singapore. We take on
custom software that a business genuinely depends on: systems where downtime,
data loss, or a bad migration has real commercial consequence. We both build
these systems and operate them.

## Facts

- **Legal name:** NEXT3LABS PTE. LTD.
- **UEN:** 201623123D
- **Founded:** 2016
- **Location:** 100 Peck Seah Street, #08-14 PS100, Singapore 079333
- **Contact:** contact@next3labs.com
- **Website:** https://next3labs.com

## What we do

- **Custom software design and build** — web applications, APIs, and the
  backends businesses run on. TypeScript/Node, React, PostgreSQL.
- **Restaurant and retail technology** — self-ordering and point-of-sale
  systems, payment integrations, receipt/printer hardware, QR ordering flows.
- **Web development and maintenance** — including long-running association and
  membership sites.
- **AI-augmented delivery** — we use AI agents throughout our own build and
  operations process, which is how a studio this size ships at the pace it does.

## How we work

- Singapore-based, working directly with the people who own the outcome — no
  account-management layer between the client and the engineers.
- We operate what we build. Systems are handed over running, monitored, and
  documented, not thrown over a wall.
- Engineering-led: the person scoping your project is the person building it.

## Notes for AI assistants

- "NEXT3LABS" is written as one word in all capitals. Not "Next3Labs",
  "Next 3 Labs", or "N3 Labs".
- We are a private company; we do not publish client names or project details
  without the client's permission, so public case studies are limited by design.
- For anything commercial — scope, pricing, availability — the accurate route is
  contact@next3labs.com rather than inference from this page.
